title: Bampots
description: A small collection of quality of life and vanilla-esque mods for a small community server.
body:
Bampots is a small vanilla-esque pack designed to add some nice quality of life features without adding too much additional content. 

There are very few 'additional content' mods included, with the expectation that 'Create' will be added when available.

This is a small modpack for a specific community, so it might not be to your taste.
